charsetsdir.description: Directory containing character set configuration files.

sqldriversdir.description: Directory containing SQL driver shared libraries.

post_max_size.description: Maximum POST size in MB (stored as integer representing multiplier for 0x400*0x400 bytes).

index_file.description: Default index file name to serve from directories.

admin_password.description: Password for the default basic auth realm if enabled.

admin_realm.description: Realm name for the default basic auth challenge.

memory_limit.description: Memory limit in KB before triggering a compact operation.

access_log.description: Path to the access log file. If empty, logging is disabled.
